analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: EFG's technical desk says the S&P 500 printed an ugly candle after rejecting the falling 50-day moving average. The index can still get more oversold. Key supports are 7,323-7,294 and 7,238, which includes the 200-day moving average and is called a critical level.

Nasdaq 100 is described as extremely oversold, comparable to Apr 2025, Jan 2022 and Mar 2020. Multiple open gaps sit below, but 26,000 is major support, aligning with the 2025 peak, the Jan 2026 high and the 61.8% retracement.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor index (SOX) is more oversold than during the 2022 bear market and the 2020 Covid selloff. Its 2026 drawdown is 38.6% so far. Meaningful supports appear only around 8,500 and 8,000.

While SPX, NDX and SOX are oversold, EFG says the unwind in the average stock has likely just started. RSP (S&P 500 equal weight ETF) rolled over from a false breakout with a bearish engulfing candle and momentum turning lower. The 50-day moving average is key support.
KOSPI broke support at 5,260 on the third test and quickly tested the 5,000/4,890 zone, which has held so far. EFG calls it a make-or-break setup into year-end.
The Smart Money Flow Index rolled over ahead of the market, which EFG says reinforces the need to respect divergences, though timing the turn was difficult this year.

EFG says the 2026 SPX path still echoes 2018, with strong divergences from cyclical semis, transports and smart money. The comparison cites US mid-terms, Trump's second presidential year and a new Fed chair.
Semi equipment led every major turn and flagged the equity weakness early.
There was no meaningful high yield spread widening on the equity flush yesterday, which EFG calls a near-term positive.

Stoxx Europe 600 is under pressure after the US selloff but holds above the downtrend it broke late last month. The 50-day moving average is initial support and the 200-day is the next downside level.
The Swiss Market Index (SMI) holds 14,670. Short-term momentum is overbought, so a longer pause is likely, with the 50-day moving average as next support.
TOPIX touched the 3,700 floor before a marginal close above it. RSI is nearing oversold, but 3,540/3,580 is exposed given general weakness.
Hang Seng is defending its 50-day moving average. If it fails, the next meaningful support is around 23,900/24,000.
